column1: # fix_id <TAB> target_file <TAB> sed_expr <TAB> test_cmd ; run in a throw-away clone only:
# Every test_cmd exits 0 on success by itself -- no `| grep -q` (pipefail + SIGPIPE scores baseline red).
# p06_scripted_run.sh runs in a throwaway workspace (the repo lock pins path deps to the primary checkout);
# p06_shape_gate.py is textual and reads the clone.
# THE PLAN'S ROW -- a consumer reads a value that is not in ext_config -> the gate or the compiler rejects:
#   (a) an inline DescribeTools lambda closing over a value     -> the GATE (payload-inline-lambda); compiler-clean
#   (b) an inline interpret lambda closing over a register local -> the GATE (payload-inline-lambda); compiler-clean
#   (c) a named callback reading a module-level `let` from Env  -> the COMPILER (a module let is rowless)

column3: s/^export func register_with_config(_cfg: a) -> ExtRegistration {$/export func register_with_config(_cfg: a) -> ExtRegistration {\n  let deny_at = 7000;/;s/repeat_prepare, repeat_interpret)\]/repeat_prepare, \\c k r o. if deny_at > 0 then repeat_interpret(c, k, r, o) else NoOpinion)]/

s/^func describe_tools(cfg: Json) -> \[ToolSchema\] {$/let catalog_env_tool = getEnvOr("MOTOKO_EXAMPLE_CATALOG_TOOL", "")\n\nfunc describe_tools(cfg: Json) -> [ToolSchema] {/;s/^  schemas_for(getStringArrayOrEmpty(cfg, "tools"))$/  schemas_for([catalog_env_tool])/

column1: # The catalog must follow ext_config: an empty config that still advertises a tool is red.
# The finalize consumer's bounds on ContinueWithFeedback: the intervention limit at interpret, the length clip.

column3: s/^      if st.interventions_used >= st.intervention_limit then NoDecision$/      if false then NoDecision/
s/^  if n <= 0 then "" else if length(s) <= n then s else substring(s, 0, n)$/  if n <= 0 then "" else s/

column3: s/^        Unavailable(_) => NoDecision,$/        Unavailable(_) => ContinueWithFeedback("backend unavailable"),/
